query: What faculty development models (micro-credentials, co-teaching, regional centers, fellowships) are most scalable and effective for preparing instructors to teach India-contextual AI ethics?

response.query: What faculty development models (micro-credentials, co-teaching, regional centers, fellowships) are most scalable and effective for preparing instructors to teach India-contextual AI ethics?
response.answer: Micro-credentials and fellowships are most scalable and effective for preparing instructors to teach India-contextual AI ethics. They provide flexible, targeted learning opportunities and professional development.
